tag Plain;
tag Boxed[T] {
    label() -> String where T: {name: String} { describe(self) }
}

use Shape = Plain | Boxed[{name: String}]

fn describe(item: {name: String}) -> String { "boxed {item.name}" }

fn first-pair(xs: [Int]) -> (Int, Int) {
    for (;;) {
        if let [$a, $b] = xs {
            return (a, b)
        }
    }
}

fn first-positive(xs: [Int]) -> Int {
    for (;;) {
        for x in xs {
            if x > 0 {
                return x
            }
        }
        break
    }
    0
}

fn label(shape: Shape) -> String {
    match shape {
        Boxed(_) as boxed => boxed.label(),
        Plain => 'plain'
    }
}

fn head(queue: SharedQueue[Int]) -> ?Int {
    match queue.try-take(0) {
        Some(value) => value,
        None => nil
    }
}

fn pair-sum(a: String, b: String) -> Int { #a + #b }
fn quad-sum(a: String, b: String, c: String, d: String) -> Int { #a + #b + #c + #d }

fn spread-sum(text: String) -> Int {
    let handlers = [(/(a)(b)/, pair-sum), (/(a)(b)(c)(d)/, quad-sum)]
    for (pattern, handler) in handlers {
        if let [matched, *captures] = text.match(pattern) {
            return handler(*captures)
        }
    }
    0
}

fn optional-head(xs: [?Int]) -> Int {
    xs[0] ?? 0
}

class Cursor {
    __state: {t: Int, y: ?Int, x: ?Int}

    init() {
        __state = {t: 0, y: nil, x: nil}
    }

    reset() {
        self.__state = {t: 0, y: nil, x: nil}
    }

    t() -> Int { __state.t }
}

fn lookup(table: Dict[String, Int], key: String) -> Int {
    match table(key) {
        Some(value) => value,
        None => -1
    }
}

fn drain*(count: Int) -> Generator[Int] {
    for i in 0..count {
        yield i
    }
}

fn first-yield() -> ?Int {
    let stream = drain(3)
    match stream() {
        Some(value) => value,
        None => nil
    }
}

let queue = SharedQueue()
queue.put(5)
let cursor = Cursor()
cursor.reset()

print(
    first-pair([1, 2]),
    first-positive([-1, 3]),
    label(Boxed({name: 'x'})),
    label(Plain),
    head(queue),
    spread-sum('ab'),
    spread-sum('abcd'),
    optional-head([nil, 2]),
    cursor.t(),
    lookup(%{'a': 1}, 'a'),
    lookup(%{'a': 1}, 'b'),
    first-yield()
)
